libmbd/libmbd.manifest:
name="libmbd"
version="0.0.0"
license="MPL-2.0"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=["src", "playground-generated"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
external-modules=["mbd_blacs", "mbd_elsi", "mbd_mpi", "mbd_scalapack"]
link=["openblas"]
[install]
library=true

scope: The serial Fortran library and Fortran-written C interface are selected from the upstream CMake target and linked with pinned OpenBLAS. MPI/ScaLAPACK and ELSI are disabled. An audited version module uses an explicitly identified 0.0.0 plus pinned-commit suffix for the Git archive, rather than claiming a release version. The checked main adapts the author's argon-dimer tests at four angstrom separation, verifies dispersion energy and gradient norm against upstream reference values, checks finite results and equal/opposite gradients, and checks library exceptions. D4 covers the Hamiltonian diagonalization used by the many-body dispersion calculation; Z denotes the domain-specific physical model, not a general-purpose eigensolver interface. Other molecules, periodic systems, distributed runs and all available models are outside this consumer verification scope. MPL-2.0 notices are retained.
initial_preparation_findings: The pinned Git archive lacks release-version metadata required by the upstream CMake configuration. Operator configuration supplies an explicit 0.0.0 plus pinned-commit suffix through the upstream version-tag input mechanism. The generated version module changes no numerical procedures. Serial energy, gradient norm and equal/opposite-gradient checks use the upstream argon-dimer reference values.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md. Audited configuration assets and original input hashes are included in local project exports; CMake is not run for visitors.
